title: Docs
helpDescription: Welcome to the fiber-crud admin system. Below are common operation guides.
gettingStartedDesc: After logging in, you will see the workspace overview page with key metrics and shortcuts.
navigationDesc: The left menu is grouped by module: System, AI, Knowledge, Search, Risk Control, Commission, Finance, etc.
commonOpsDesc: Most list pages support search, create, edit, delete, and status toggle. Click a table row to view details.
permissionsDesc: The system uses RBAC model. Admins can configure role permissions in System → Role Management.
shortcutsDesc: The workspace homepage provides quick links to frequently used features.
